source: Weekly refresh by Claude (scheduled task). Edit freely; the next refresh replaces this file.

items.title: Black Friday (27 Nov) gift voucher: last call carousel
items.why: This is the final week before Black Friday, and a shoot voucher is an easy Christmas gift people can buy without knowing the date yet.
items.tip: Slide 1 the offer and the Friday deadline, slides 2 to 4 sample shots, last slide how to pay. Repost it to Stories on Thursday and Friday.

items.title: Festive lights and halaal market vendor reels
items.why: The Joburg Zoo Festival of Lights opens on 26 Nov and the strEATery halaal food market runs 27 to 29 Nov, so warm festive content is peaking right now.
items.tip: Film a 3 clip story of one food stall (prep, plating, first bite) and offer the vendor the edit as a paid promo package.

items.title: Day of Reconciliation (16 Dec) portrait series
items.why: A public holiday about coming together gives you a local, meaningful hook that brands and followers like to share.
items.tip: Shoot 5 to 8 quick portraits of different Joburg people in one spot, add a one line quote each, and post on the morning of the 16th.

items.title: Your 2026 in 10 frames
items.why: End of year recap and photo dump posts get saved and shared heavily from late November through December.
items.tip: Pick one best shot per category (sport, cars, events, brands), put the strongest first, and end with 'January dates open' and a booking link.

items.title: Post originals, not reposts
items.why: Instagram has been cutting reach for reposted and lightly edited content and pushing original creators higher in Reels.
items.tip: Never upload a clip with another app's watermark. Re-cut and re-grade for each platform instead of copying the same file across.

items.title: Test new hooks with Trial Reels first
items.why: Trial Reels are shown to non-followers first, so you can see which opening wins before it touches your main grid.
items.tip: Post the same edit with two different first 2 seconds as trials, then share the winner to your followers.

items.title: Big December crowds: shoot the build-up, not the stage
items.why: FNB Stadium concerts and the Proteas home summer bring huge crowds in December, and arrival energy content travels well even when pro cameras are not allowed inside.
items.tip: Film fans arriving, face paint, merch stalls and the walk in, cut to the beat, and tag the event page.

items.title: Raw clip to final edit on the beat drop
items.why: The freeze then reveal transition is still widely copied and shows your grading skill in a few seconds.
items.tip: Start on a flat ungraded car or sport clip, freeze on the beat, then cut to the finished graded version.

items.title: December availability calendar story
items.why: Year end functions and family shoots fill fast, and a simple 'dates left' story pushes people who were waiting to decide.
items.tip: Post a calendar graphic with open dates crossed off as they book, add a link sticker, and update it every few days.

items.title: Say your keywords out loud and on screen
items.why: Instagram reads on-screen text and voiceover to decide who sees a reel, not only captions and hashtags.
items.tip: Say 'Johannesburg event photographer' in the first few seconds and repeat it in a text overlay.
